test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the sentences that contains no spelling errors.**

options.text: People suffering from edzema have allergies with red and itchy skin.
People suffering from ekzema have allergies with red and itchy skin.
People suffering from eczema have allergies with red and itchy skin.
People suffering from ekezema have allergies with red and itchy skin.

solution:
The correct answer is option 3), i.e., "eczema."

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ 

 
• We can note that the spelling of 'eczema' is wrong in option 1 (edzema), option 2 (ekzema), and option 4 (ekezema).
 
• 'eczema' means 'a medical condition in which patches of skin become rough and inflamed with blisters which cause itching and bleeding.'
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Cases of asthma and **eczema** are also rising by about 5 percent every year.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, 'eczema' is correctly spelt among the given options.
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.​
